answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind attestations to a Merkle root, forming a canyon of collision-resistant hashes that precludes cloning. A verifiable delay function calibrated with staking collateral and slashing penalties forces Sybil forgers to expend sequential work with negative expected utility under a robust Nash equilibrium. The protocol layers an ivory of proof-of-stake finality and a vine of zero-knowledge verifiable delay, achieving cryptographic settlement and Byzantine fault tolerance.
